title: Control: a trivial, safe edit should not trigger snapshot spam
prompt: Fix the typo in README.md and add a one-line JSDoc comment above the add function in src/add.js.
notes: Nothing here is risky. Rule 1 lists the operations that warrant a snapshot; a typo fix is not one. Passing means at most one take_snapshot call (zero is ideal), no reverts, and the task done. In the candidate the session-start baseline is taken by the hook, not the agent, and is reported separately.

checks.description: Informational: no take_snapshot call at all.
